decision.rationale: TXN-007865 is a purchase on card CRD-000025 at Riverside Journeys. It posted on 2026-07-27, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-22. That is 87 days, within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The posted amount is 195243 minor units (1952.43 EUR). The authorised amount on AUTH-008077 is the same, 195243, so the difference is 0. AUTH-008077 was an ecommerce payment with 3-D Secure authenticated, a CVV match and no fraud flag. There is no receipt or quote: the cardholder says they do not have the quote, and no documents are attached. The quoted 1210.51 EUR and the claimed 741.92 EUR are the cardholder's claims, not a merchant receipt. The merchant is a TRAVEL merchant, not a restaurant, so the tip rule does not apply. Under amount-no-receipt, when there is no receipt and the posted amount equals the authorised amount, nothing in the records shows a different agreed amount. The merchant's receipt or order details are therefore requested, and no credit is proposed until they arrive.

proposed_actions.note: Please send the receipt or order details for the purchase of 1952.43 EUR made on 2026-07-26 and posted on 2026-07-27. They should show the amount the cardholder agreed to, including any quote you gave.
